articles.summary: Odyssey Marine Exploration, Inc. (NASDAQ: OMEX), an ocean exploration pioneer engaged in the discovery, validation, and development of subsea strategic minerals that provide solutions to global challenges, today announced CEO Mark Gordon will present at the Emerging Growth Conference on September 25, 2025, at 3:10 PM EST. Registration for the Emerging Growth Conference is available here . An archived webcast will be posted on EmergingGrowth.com and the Emerging Growth YouTube Channel . Mr. Gordon will provide an update on Odysseys portfolio of projects and discuss the increasing recognition of ocean resources within the U.S. critical minerals strategy. U.S. interest in critical minerals continues to accelerate, driven by a mix of publicprivate investment, government initiatives, and a drive toward expedited permitting pathwaysincluding for ocean resourcesthat are moving from policy to action, said Mark Gordon, Chief Executive Officer and
articles.title: Odyssey Marine Exploration CEO to Present Critical Minerals Ocean Resource Opportunities at Emerging Growth Conference
